explanation: erdosproblems.com/499: van der Waerden's conjecture perm(M) ≥ n^{−n} n! for doubly stochastic M, proved by Gyires, Egorychev and Falikman. The Lean statement: for M ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ (Fin n), (n:ℝ)^(−n) · n! ≤ M.permanent. The equality characterisation mentioned on the page is not included, but the inequality is the main claim. Faithful.
